input.brief: Kosovo-based revenue company: outbound sales for growing companies plus outsourced English-speaking talent from Prishtina, and a 10% lifetime referral share for fractional CFOs and advisors

direction.name: The sentence is the layout
direction.idea: One short sentence, set at poster scale, is the composition. The trick that makes it an idea rather than a big headline: something from the subject sits inside the sentence where a word would be. A strip of photograph fills the gap between two words; a small live fragment of the product replaces the noun; the object the sentence names is pictured at the size of a letter. Write the sentence first, find the word that can be shown instead of said, and put the showing in its place. The reader completes the sentence with their eyes.
direction.composition: The sentence is four to seven words and runs as one or two full-width lines at 9–13vw. Inline with the type, on the baseline, sits one media slot: a rounded-rectangle or square frame exactly one line-height tall and two to three ems wide, holding a photograph or a looping crop. Above and below the sentence the screen is empty except for a small navigation line and one supporting sentence set small, both on the same left margin. Later sections repeat the grammar at smaller scale: each is a short statement on the left six columns with its proof (image, figure, list) on the right, so the page reads as a series of sentences with evidence. Generous vertical space (160px or more) between sections.
direction.typography: Display weight with real presence (medium to bold), tracking -0.03 to -0.05em, leading 0.95–1.0 so two lines sit close. The inline frame aligns to cap height and baseline exactly; set it with em units so it scales with the type.
direction.colour: A calm ground with ink at full contrast. The only colour comes from the photograph inside the sentence; if the palette has an accent, use it once, on the action.
direction.imagery: One strong, simple photograph that reads at small size (a face, an object, a texture, a horizon), cropped to a wide strip inside the sentence. The same image may open to full width in the next section, so the small slot feels like a window onto something larger.
direction.richness: The collision of big type and one live image inside it. Because there is only one image on the first screen, choose it with care and give it perfect alignment to the letters.
direction.pitfalls: The sentence must be short enough for two lines on a phone, where the inline frame drops to its own line between the two halves. Do not style one word differently to fake the device. Do not use more than one slot per sentence.

hero.name: Headline across two fields
hero.blueprint: The viewport is two flat fields meeting at exactly half height: paper above, one saturated colour below, with a hard edge and nothing drawn on it. A two-line headline in black-weight capitals at clamp(96px, 9.5vw, 150px), line-height 0.86, is centred across the seam and spans about 70% of the width, so line one stands on the upper field and line two is cut through its upper third by the seam. The type changes ink where it crosses: above the seam it takes the accent ink, below it a deep ink two steps darker than the lower field, as if submerged. Build it as two stacked copies of the same headline, one per ink, the first clipped with `clip-path: inset(0 0 50% 0)` and the second with `inset(50% 0 0 0)`. Wordmark top-left at 28px; up to four text links and the single action, a solid rectangular button, top-right. One supporting sentence at 20px in the paper colour is centred on the lower field, 56px above the bottom edge. The lower field continues for 30svh past the fold before the next colour begins.
hero.mobile: The same two fields with the seam at 46svh. The headline stays on two lines at 15vw, centred, still cut by the seam and still changing ink. Wordmark top-left and the action button top-right; the links drop into one menu word beside it. The supporting sentence sits on the lower field at 16px, centred, max 28ch, with 40px beneath it.
hero.headline: A statement of two to four words on two lines, up to about 10 characters per line, whose meaning the rising field acts out.

type.note: Hairline serif capitals set large enough that the thin strokes read as drawing, with a small neutral sans for everything practical. Suits lodges, spas, architecture and interiors; keep it on flat pale or dark fields where the strokes have full contrast.

motion.name: Colour by chapter
motion.description: Each chapter is its own full-bleed field of one palette colour, so the ground changes exactly at section edges as you scroll, never as a global recolouring of the screen. The only movement: the fixed header (or the one pinned element) takes the ink of the chapter beneath it, switching with a 300ms colour transition as each edge passes under it. Do not drive the page background from an observer: in blind tests a page recoloured mid-section, with a paragraph sitting on two colours, read as broken twice.

sections.name: Object in front of type
sections.blueprint: Type and object share one space instead of sitting side by side. Three or four lines of display type, one or two words each, are stacked flush left at clamp(72px, 9vw, 150px) with leading 0.88, starting on the left margin and allowed to leave the right edge (white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden on the section). The lines step through tones of one ink: one at 45%, one at full strength, the rest at 18%. The object photograph, a cut-out or a studio shot blended with multiply, is absolutely positioned over the upper right of the stack at 40–46vw wide, rotated no more than 6 degrees and above the type in the stacking order, so it hides parts of three or four letters. Under the stack, in columns 8–12, a two-paragraph block at 20px gives the facts. The full-strength line is the heading; nothing sits above it.
sections.mobile: Type drops to 15vw and still runs off the right edge. The object sits at 78vw wide, overlapping the last two lines from below instead of from the right, and is cropped by the right edge. The facts block follows at full width and 17px.

sections.name: Statement, table pushed right
sections.blueprint: A heading of four to six words spans the full width on two lines at clamp(40px, 4.5vw, 68px), left-aligned with its first line indented 3vw and leading 0.98. 96px below, the table is pushed into the right-hand five columns (8–12) and the left stays open. One plain word naming the table (offices, hours, rates) hangs at 14px in column 7, top-aligned with the first row. Each row is a three-part line at 15–16px with 26px between rows: the kind or day in the soft ink at the left of the measure, the place or service at 30%, and the address, time or price right-aligned, with a small arrow where the row links. Rows are separated by space only; every fourth row has 44px above it to form groups. In columns 1–4, bottom-aligned with the last row, one 4:5 photograph 22vw wide may sit alone. Holds 5–14 rows.
sections.mobile: Heading at 9.5vw without the indent. The table takes the full width at 16px; each row stacks the kind above the place, with the value right-aligned on the first line. The naming word is dropped because the heading already says it. The photograph follows at 60% width on the right margin.

sections.name: Lines that step across
sections.blueprint: The sequence is written, not counted. Four lines of display type, one stage per line, each a complete short clause that begins with its order word: 'First you send it.' 'Then we take it apart.' 'You choose one.' 'It ships on Friday.' Set at clamp(36px, 4.6vw, 76px), leading 1.0, one line each. The first line starts on column 1 and each following line starts two columns further right (grid-column-start 1, 3, 5, 7), so the block descends as a staircase and the eye follows the diagonal. Under each line, on that line's own left edge and 12px below, a sentence of up to 34ch at 17px in the soft ink. 56px between stages. The last line may take the accent colour as the single emphasis. The first line serves as the heading; there is no title above. Leave the columns to the left of the final stage empty.
sections.mobile: Lines drop to 8.4vw and may wrap onto a second line. The staircase becomes a smaller indent of 6vw per stage, so the fourth line starts 18vw in. Each sentence sits under its line at 16px on the same indent. 40px between stages.

sections.name: Column aligned on the decimal
sections.blueprint: A tall column of figures set like a ledger. Left, columns 1–5: the heading as a statement of up to five words on two lines at clamp(32px, 3.2vw, 52px), its first line in the soft ink and its second in full ink, placed at mid-height. Right, columns 7–12: four to six figures stacked, each at clamp(64px, 7vw, 112px), leading 1.0, in tabular lining numerals. They align on the decimal point: each row is a three-part grid in which the whole-number part is right-aligned in the first track, the point and decimals are left-aligned in the second, and a caption of one or two lines at 16px sits in the third, on the figure's baseline. Whole numbers simply leave the second track empty. Rows are separated by 20px of space only. Units are written in the captions, not attached to the figures, so the numerals form one clean vertical shape.
sections.mobile: The heading comes first at 28px. Figures drop to 15vw and keep the decimal alignment, with the split at 52% of the width. Each caption moves under its figure at 15px, starting from the left margin. 28px between rows.

sections.name: Portrait as drop cap
sections.blueprint: No heading. One biography paragraph of 50–80 words is set large at clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 38px), regular weight, leading 1.2, across columns 3–12 of the grid. A square portrait is floated at the paragraph's start with `float: left`: its side equals three lines of text (3.6em), with 0.5em of space to its right, so the first three lines wrap beside it and the fourth returns to the paragraph's left edge, like a drop capital. Square corners. The person's name, the first words of the paragraph, is in full ink; the rest may be in a softer ink with linked names in full ink and underlined. A second paragraph follows after one blank line in the soft ink at the same size. Columns 1–2 hold three short facts (place, since when, how to reach) at 14px, top-aligned with the portrait. Section padding 140px.
sections.mobile: Text at 22px with leading 1.25, full width. The portrait keeps its float but grows to four lines tall, about 110px square. The three facts move below the second paragraph as a single row of three small blocks at 13px.

sections.name: Sentence, portrait, two links
sections.blueprint: One closing row of three elements hanging from the same top line, with open ground between them, on a 12-column grid. Columns 1–5: a sentence of 12–18 words at clamp(26px, 3vw, 44px), four lines, leading 1.1, saying what kind of enquiries are welcome; it is set as a paragraph and there is no separate heading. Columns 8–9: one small square portrait or photograph of the place, 150–170px, with square corners. Columns 10–12: a short question at 18px in medium weight, then 20px below it two underlined links stacked at 18px (the email address and one booking or social link), and beneath them a line at 14px in the soft ink with the city and the usual reply time. Columns 6–7 stay empty. The row has 160px of space above and 120px below. No form. On a dark ground the photograph is the only bright thing in the row.
sections.mobile: The sentence comes first at 7.4vw. Below it the portrait at 96px square sits at the left margin with the question and the two links to its right, top-aligned, in the remaining width. The city and reply-time line spans the full width beneath.

sections.name: Invitation over a cropped name
sections.blueprint: Close and footer in one full-viewport field of the inverse colour. Upper third, columns 1–7: a two-line invitation at about 5vw, three to five words, with one filled rectangular button beneath it. At columns 10–12, top-aligned with the invitation, three or four social or contact links stacked at 16px. The wordmark fills the bottom of the screen at 26–30vw on one line, `white-space: nowrap`, heavier and larger than the viewport can hold: it is pushed down with `transform: translateY(30%)` so the bottom edge cuts through the letters, and a long name also runs off the right edge. `overflow: hidden` on the footer does the cropping. One row of credits and legal links at 13px sits directly above the wordmark's cap line, spread left and right. The cropped name must be recognisable from its upper two-thirds alone; test that it is.
sections.mobile: Invitation at 11vw on two lines at the top with a full-width button. Links follow as one row of words at 15px. The wordmark sits at 34vw at the bottom, cropped by both the bottom and the right edge, with the legal row above it at 12px.

references.name: Spatial
references.idea: Typography behaves like sound in a room: plain black statements swell, stretch and bend through an empty white viewport as you scroll.
references.hero: A white viewport holding only the festival dates: two centred lines in Neue Haas Grotesk Roman at roughly 6.7vw, black, tight leading, sitting at the exact vertical middle and spanning about half the width. Large empty fields above and below; no image, no button, no supporting copy. The header is the only other element: a light uppercase wordmark with tight tracking flush to the top-left corner at a 20px inset, and nine small bold uppercase links in a row across the top right. Mobile is the same poster at 40px with a two-line hamburger.
references.type: One face, Neue Haas Grotesk Display 55 Roman, for everything: statements from 56px up to about 10vw, 13px body, bold 13px uppercase navigation, a timetable at about 16px with tight leading. Statement lines are distorted per glyph, each letter scaled to a different width and height.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #e8a25c — Pure black on pure white; the programme section inverts to white on black. The only colour is the amber haze of a single photograph.
references.imagery: Almost none. The images are canvas-rendered text statements warped and magnified until letter fragments become abstract black shapes cropped by the viewport. One warm, hazy venue photograph sits inset at half width beside body copy, square-cornered.
references.layout: Full width with 10 to 20px margins. Opens with one centred statement per screen, then drops into left-aligned two-column copy and, further down, edge-to-edge four-column timetables. The swing between empty poster screens and tightly packed listings is the page's rhythm.

sections.description: A run of full-viewport white screens, each carrying one centred two-line sentence. The text is drawn on canvas and deformed: letters within a word have different widths and heights and baselines wobble. Between screens the type is magnified so far that only the strokes and counters of a few letters cross the frame, cropped on every side, while a small readable version of the next sentence appears inside the wreckage of the previous one.

A calm reset: a three-line centred statement at about 5vw in undistorted type fills the top half. At the bottom, a column of 16px body copy about 650px wide sits flush to the left margin, and an amber-toned photograph starts at the horizontal centre and runs to the right margin with square corners, cropped by the fold.

Black full-bleed section. Day headings are single small lines above a hairline; under each, a four-column table spans the full width: artist flush left, format at one third, room at two thirds, time range right-aligned at the far edge. Rows are about 35px high with a hairline between each, all in the same 30px grotesk with no bold; changeovers are marked by rows in capitals.

steal: Open with a single factual line (the dates) centred on an otherwise empty white screen instead of a branded hero.
Scale each letter of a statement independently in width and height so plain grotesk type looks as if it is resonating.
Set a programme as a full-width four-column hairline table in one size and weight, times right-aligned, on an inverted background.

references.name: Midnight
references.idea: The headline's circles are literally pictured: one blurred dark ring, sliced into horizontal bands, becomes the hero, the demo panel, the session cards and the footer.
references.hero: No navigation at all. A canvas fills the full width and the top 90% of the viewport: a huge out-of-focus dark navy ring on drifting taupe, sage and terracotta, cut into horizontal bands about 78px tall that are slightly offset like blinds. On the vertical centre line, starting 58px from the left, sit a small rounded-square line icon and a one-line headline at 48px in cream. On the same baseline, starting 59% across, a two-line 17px statement whose first sentence is white and bold while the rest drops to half opacity. The cream page background shows as a 90px strip at the bottom. No button.
references.type: Public Sans only, weight 500, tracking −0.04em. Headline 48px, mid-page statement about 38px on five centred lines, body 13–17px. Signature device: within one paragraph the first sentence is full strength and the remainder faded, replacing the usual heading-plus-subhead pair.
references.colour: #f4efe6 #07172a #867768 #687674 #a8735c #faf7f1 — Warm cream pages against midnight navy; the gradient mixes muted taupe, sage and terracotta around the dark ring. A peach-cream fills the small pill button. No bright accent anywhere.
references.imagery: An animated blurred ring gradient with band displacement and fine grain, used full-bleed in hero and footer, inset with 8px corners as the demo panel, and miniaturised onto three portrait session cards. No photos or UI screenshots.
references.layout: 30px side margins. Sections alternate between full-bleed gradient and cream type-only screens. Section headers split into left title and right small paragraph. Text blocks are short and often occupy one half of the width, leaving the other empty (the FAQ sits entirely in the right half).

sections.description: A full cream viewport with one centred paragraph of five lines at roughly 38px, about 820px wide. Only the opening sentence is dark; the remaining words are pale and darken progressively with scroll. Later, three small portrait cards, each about 115×180px with a mini gradient, a date at the top and a two-line label bottom-left, fan across the right side of the text, overlapping it with a soft shadow.

Header row: a two-line title at 34px on the left, a three-line 12px grey paragraph in the last fifth on the right. Below, a gradient panel spans the full content width, about 650px tall with 8px corners, holding a centred question at 34px in cream, a one-line caption, and an email capsule with an inline peach button; a small play capsule sits centred near its bottom edge.

A left-aligned two-line lead uses the dark-then-faded sentence device. Under it a two-by-two arrangement with no cards or borders, columns starting at 0 and 50%: each item is a 24px pale rounded-square icon, a quoted question as a 13px semibold title, then three or four lines of grey 12px text about 300px wide. A waitlist capsule floats fixed at bottom centre.

FAQ rows with hairlines and chevrons occupy only the right half of the screen above. The footer is the gradient again, full-bleed and about 190px tall: a two-line cream statement at left, an email capsule with inline button at right on the same line, and a row of tiny grey legal links along the bottom.

steal: Slice a soft blurred gradient into horizontal bands with small offsets so a familiar glow becomes a recognisable, ownable texture.
Replace heading-plus-subhead with one paragraph whose first sentence is full contrast and the rest half opacity.
Remove the nav from the hero entirely and put headline left and supporting line right on one shared baseline at mid-height.

references.name: Hildén & Kaira
references.idea: The agency name is cast in liquid chrome across the full width, and the same chrome becomes emoji that float through the page, tying a social-media pitch to one material.
references.hero: Warm light-grey field. The lowercase serif wordmark, rendered as polished chrome 3D letters with a molten ampersand, runs edge to edge across the top quarter (about 220px tall, 16px side margins). A tilted portrait video roughly 180 by 220px covers two of its letters. Directly under the wordmark, four small nav links centred. Then 300px of nothing, with one chrome flame emoji floating at the far left. The headline sits in the bottom third: three centred lines of narrow display serif at 4.4vw, leading so tight that descenders touch ascenders, a two-line 15px sans sub, and two square-cornered buttons, black and pale lime.
references.type: PP Editorial New 400 for headlines at 63px, -0.02em tracking and leading near 0.9; PP Neue Montreal 13px for nav, body and buttons. The jump is roughly 5:1 with nothing in between. Stat numerals use the sans at about 60px.
references.colour: #eae9e6 #181818 #ecfdad #b5b5b5 #ffffff #3aa57a — Warm grey and near-black alternate by section. Pale lime is the single accent: secondary buttons, headline text on dark, stat tiles and service cards. Chrome silver recurs as a material.
references.imagery: Chrome 3D-rendered lettering and emoji objects (flame, heart, dove, microphone, wink) floating free; vertical phone videos of client content shown as fanned, slightly rotated stacks with white borders. Square corners throughout.
references.layout: Centred statements with large voids, alternating light and dark full-width bands. Content arrives as square-cornered slabs: a white case card on grey, lime service cards stacking over each other on black. Chrome objects break the grid at the edges.

sections.description: Full-viewport near-black band. A two-line centred serif statement in pale lime at about 4vw sits in the upper third with nothing near it. Two small testimonials are pushed to the bottom-left and bottom-right corners: five tiny stars, two lines of 11px sans, name and title, each centred in its own narrow block. The centre bottom is left empty.

Horizontal carousel of wide white slabs on the grey ground, the next slide peeking at the right edge. Left half: a two-line serif title top-left, then far below a red-dot label over a thin rule and two flat tiles side by side, a wide lime one and a narrower brushed-chrome one, each with a tiny caption and a 60px sans numeral. Right half: a grey panel with three vertical videos fanned like playing cards.

On black, a centred serif section title, then service cards that pin and stack: a lime slab about 55% wide with serif title top-left, grey serif index number top-right, a small paragraph and black button bottom-left and a vertical video inset bottom-right. White and green slabs peek out beneath it, offset downward, and the top card tilts a degree or two as it scrolls.

A full brushed-silver gradient field. The chrome wordmark repeats at full width across the top. Bottom-left, a small serif label over two short link columns; bottom-right, two square translucent tiles each holding a chrome object (microphone, heart) with a serif label above and three tiny square social buttons below. A hairline and a legal row close it.

steal: Render the wordmark in one physical material and reuse that material for small floating objects, so decoration and logo are the same thing.
Leave a third of the hero empty between a top-edge wordmark and a bottom-third headline; the gap makes both read.
Set a display serif with leading under 1.0 so lines interlock, and pair it with 13px sans for everything else.
